package: product-wave-07 / D：真实双二进制升级、数据保护与恢复切换消费
scopeNote: Package-scoped candidate evidence. Not main/E admission, not installed-alpha. Recovery activation commit is main-owned and still unpublished; binary switching is measured only for the two frozen artifacts below.

modelBudget.note: No model/native send; all probes are local fixture instances and frozen installs.

d1.summary: PA_CONFIG_ROOT/--config-root first-run now adopts the release manifest baked into the install after verifying every install byte (size+sha256), buildId/source agreement and artifact containment. Different source is a conflict, tamper/wrong root/missing manifest are refusals; a source checkout reports unverified provenance and writes no release. main 0028 fresh-source null-source crash fixed; doctor adds release_binding; smoke covers unicode/space config roots, foreign install refusal and fresh-source CLI.

d2.summary: Two frozen installs from two different clean commits: baseline wave06-alpha2 (build 7e8f6ce6fa2e2633, source e10bfdb, 6603 files) and target wave07-target (build 9120a5ed858e0feb, source 76f26a6, 6629 files). Both source.dirty=false, out of Git, schema 13, darwin/arm64 + Node 24.21.x + SQLite ABI 137. Digests/dependency closures recorded; tag-only rebuild is not used as evidence.

d3.summary: pa upgrade verifies the target inventory byte-for-byte before touching the instance, takes a pre-upgrade backup, stops only the verified recorded instance (a live unverified pid blocks instead of being killed), keeps the previous pointer, swaps release.json with a journal, starts the target on the same roots and requires its own buildId/health. Failed start reverts the pointer without touching data. Recipe proves: switch, post-upgrade data survives a binary-only rollback, schema-incompatible older binary refuses the state, tampered target, running switch, unverified live instance, unhealthy target, crash-after-swap recovery and duplicate refusal.
d3.dataProtection: Post-upgrade records were written under the target build and remained readable after rollback to the baseline binary; evidence digest unchanged. Rollback is binary-only, dataRolledBack=false.

d4.summary: main publishes only read-only inspect/prepare plus the internal RecoveryActivationIntent/RecoveryActivationFacts contract; no commit route or committed receipt exists. D added a pure local precondition gate (expiry, digest drift, distinct private roots, half-prepared target, instance/credential/native-session/activation residue, replay) and a CLI that reports BLOCKED with the exact main-owned requirements; smoke proves it never writes the restored DB/marker, never prepares the target and never reports authorization.
d4.blockedBy: main recovery commit/activation route + committed source receipt

d5.summary: Reentrant operations from a fresh root: install/first-run/doctor/start/status/backup/stop plus the two-artifact upgrade/rollback recipe; diagnostics report the release binding, upgrade journal and exact refusal codes; failures covered include corrupt target bytes, running switch, unverified live pid, unhealthy target, crash-after-swap + recover, duplicate request, schema-incompatible binary and corrupt/missing state. Cleanup only removes the operation own temp roots.
notTested: targeted SIGKILL at every individual switch step (only crash-after-swap is injected)
orphan staging cleanup outside D-owned temp roots

d6.summary: Both artifacts frozen with install/release/closure/tar digests; E recipe published and re-run here from the tars: extract-verify, first-run/doctor, static workbench, backup, binary switch, target identity/doctor/journal, binary-only rollback with unchanged evidence (7/7 PASS). E independent acceptance is still pending.

blockers.summary: No recovery commit route/committed receipt; D4 partial. D publishes exact required inputs and refuses to start anything from a local check.
No machine-readable executor capability/session; review execution remains experimental and disabled by default.
E must run the published recipe against the two frozen tars from its own root; D does not edit E assertions.
Both wave-07 artifacts are schema 13. A different-schema binary is refused (wave-06 schema-12 control), but a real schema-changing binary pair is not available yet.

notTested: a schema-changing binary pair (only refusal of an older schema is measured)
SIGKILL injected at every individual switch step
eConsumption: Use the two frozen tars and digests in tools/distribution/reports/wave07/artifacts.json; do not mix in the author checkout or main new source.
Run node tools/distribution/verify-upgrade-artifact.mjs with both tars and both published sha256 values from a fresh root; expect 7/7 PASS.
For deeper failure-window coverage run smoke-binary-upgrade with the two frozen install directories; it exercises the negatives listed in D3/D5.
Do not relax digest checks, delete restore markers, hand-edit release.json, or claim schema migration/native/recovery-activation from these results.
preservedHistory: no shared contract/migration/root lock/other-agent tests/user services modified
no restore marker deleted, no force switch, no silent data rollback
